arguments.sql:
SELECT
    cards.power,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cards.side IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_with_side,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ',' || cards.types || ',' LIKE '%,Creature,%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS creature_rows
FROM cards
WHERE cards.power IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY cards.power
ORDER BY CAST(cards.power AS REAL), cards.power
